meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 它会先复现你报的缺陷,在临时工作区写出最小修复并跑通验证,然后交付:上游 openai/codex 走 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷则在 code-yeongyu/lazycodex 提已验证修复的 issue(不开 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求修复某个 bug、贡献 bug 修复,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下这个 Codex CLI 的 bug,复现步骤在下面
say.note: 先复现,再决定提 fork PR 还是 issue

say.text: 这个 LazyCodex 安装器的缺陷帮我修好并提交
say.note: LazyCodex 自身的缺陷会以已验证 issue 提交

say.text: 帮我调试这个 hook 问题并提一个修复
say.note: 先定位根因,再产出最小修复补丁

howto.what_en: It reproduces the reported defect, writes the smallest correct fix in a fresh temp workspace, verifies it, then delivers: a fork PR for upstream openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR there).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or debug and open a PR for a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this Codex CLI bug; repro steps are below.
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then routes to a fork PR or issue.

say_en.text: Fix the LazyCodex installer defect and submit it.
say_en.note: LazyCodex-owned defects go out as a verified-fix issue.

say_en.text: Debug this hook problem and open a fix.
say_en.note: Finds the root cause, produces the smallest patch.
